policy: Delta is additive audit knowledge. It does not authorize schema changes or official-facing action.

new_findings.summary: German device-class table and glossary print OnBordUnit even though the text says device-class terms are XML enumeration values; English tables and exact Enumerations V2.2/V2.4 XSDs use OnBoardUnit.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: XSD accepts OnBoardUnit, not the German OnBordUnit spelling; do not create an alias

new_findings.summary: German addressing chapter numbers both IP-Adressen and Subnetzmasken/Gateways as 2.1.1 while English correctly uses 2.1.1 and 2.1.2.
English IBIS-IP version-character list contains digit 2 twice; German list contains each digit once.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: none; duplicate does not change the actual allowed character set

new_findings.summary: System-start/DNS-SD examples and glossary retain typo-like technical identifiers including DeviceManagmenService, CustomumerInformationService, DeviceManagmentServices and PassengerCountigService.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: do not synthesize misspelled service names as DNS-SD identities, schema values or aliases

new_findings.summary: Section 1.5 says each service is versioned independently and there is no common IBIS-IP version, while section 2.5 still says further protocols are not considered by version 1.0 of IBIS-IP.
new_findings.normative_validation_impact: do not infer a global IBIS-IP schema/profile version; routing remains service-specific

existing_finding_updates.effect: Regression history established: unresolved Word cross-reference placeholders are present in V2.2, absent in the fresh V2.3 read, and reintroduced at multiple locations in V2.4.
V2.4 still contains the material German/English IP-allocation conflict.
English V2.4 still cites RFC 2927 for automatic/link-local addressing while bibliography uses RFC 3927.
V2.4 SRV Weight description still states lower weight is preferred.
German V2.4 still duplicates subsection number 3.3.1 for SRV and TXT; English uses 3.3.1/3.3.2.
V2.4 operation notation still maps UnsubscribeData to TerminateSubscribeRequest/ResponseStructure.
V2.4 system-start text still points DeviceManagementService to VDV 301-2-2.
Resolved in V2.4 publication: Version 2.3 history subheadings are correctly numbered 7.2.1 and 7.2.2.

positive_authority_evidence: V2.4 chapter 6 explicitly states that XSD definitions take precedence over documentation in case of inconsistencies.
V2.4 German DNS-SD TXT Table 3 adds the previously missing train/device entries.
V2.4 version history explicitly records both changes.
